ai-music-generator.name: AI music generator
ai-music-generator.blurb: Original instrumental loops: melody, bass and drums. WAV and MIDI.

ai-music-generator.q1: How does the AI music generator work?
ai-music-generator.a1: MusicVAE, an open model from Google's Magenta project, writes 4 bars of melody, bass and drums at a time; longer pieces morph from one idea to another. The page then plays the notes with its own synthesizers.
ai-music-generator.q2: Can I use the music in videos or commercially?
ai-music-generator.a2: Yes. Every piece is newly generated, the model is Apache-2.0, and nothing is sampled from existing songs. Use it in videos, games, podcasts or products, no credit needed.
ai-music-generator.q3: Does it make songs with vocals?
ai-music-generator.a3: No. It makes instrumental music: a lead melody, a bass line and drums. Download the MIDI file to play the same notes with other instruments in GarageBand, FL Studio or any DAW.
ai-music-generator.a4: No. The model downloads once (about 18 MB) and runs in this tab; the audio is rendered in the browser too.
ai-music-generator.q5: How do I get music I like?
ai-music-generator.a5: Generate a few times and keep the one you like, then press More like this for variations of it. Calm keeps the music simple and repetitive; Wild tries bolder ideas.

ai-music-generator.lead: Make an original instrumental loop in this tab.
ai-music-generator.s1b: Choose lo-fi, pop, chiptune, ambient or dance, a length of 4, 8 or 16 bars, and how surprising it should be.
ai-music-generator.s2b: The model downloads once, then composes melody, bass and drums in a second and plays them in a loop. Press More like this for variations.
